ENTERTAINMENTS DUTY ACT 1953

ENTERTAINMENTS DUTY (EXEMPTION) (NO. 2) ORDER 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 12(1)(b)

of the Entertainments Duty Act 1953 [Act 103], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Entertainments Duty (Exemption) (No. 2)

Order 2026.

Exemption

2. The Minister exempts the admission ticket for the shows specified in column (2)

of the Schedule which were held at Bukit Jalil Axiata Arena, Kuala Lumpur on the dates

specified in column (3) from entertainments duty.
